C1656.title: Unauthorized Access to Hospital App GraphQL API Exposes Millions of Sensitive Records
C1656.summary: During a risk assessment of a hospital in April 2023, Tencent security experts discovered that its mobile app exposed a GraphQL endpoint with introspection enabled. This allowed mapping of all available APIs, many of which lacked authentication. The flaws permitted direct access to millions of sensitive records including patient identities and medical visits, and even exposed unauthenticated data

references.title: A Million-Level Sensitive Data Leak Caused by an API Unauthorized Vulnerability - Tencent News
Exposed! How a Single API Flaw Put Millions of Medical Records at Risk
